reproduction.notes: Fully offline and deterministic: no RNG, no catalogue downloads, no network at run time. Every DESI uncertainty and correlation is derived in code from covariance blocks transcribed verbatim from the cited secondary source; none is hand-typed. The quintessence background is integrated exactly (no slow-roll approximation) with a shooting condition that forces E(z=0) = 1 to machine precision; the interacting-sector background is closed-form from the sympy lemma L5. Disk footprint is a few hundred kB.
